description: Search the 500 largest-coverage U.S. four-year colleges that clear the positive-NPV envelope. Each row: 30-year NPV at resident and non-resident pricing, total cost of attendance, median earnings 10 years after entry, and break-even age. Filter by name substring, state, and control; sorted by resident NPV descending unless overridden. Use the returned slug with get_college.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the college name.

name: search_colleges
title: Search colleges by name/state
